# Public tests for the fee calculator (data/feecalc/original.rs).
# One test per line: <input as hex, or - for empty> <value the original returns>.
# The expected values were produced by running the original module:
#   target/debug/skarbnik-check-output run --module original.wasm --input <hex>
-                                        0      # no amounts
05                                       1      # one small amount
0a0b0c                                   1      # three amounts
6464646464                               13     # total 500
6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f6f                       25     # total 999, just under 1000
c8c8c8c8c8                               25     # total 1000
c8c8c8c8c828                             26     # total 1040
c8c8c8c8c8c8c8c8c8c8                     50     # total 2000
ffffffffffffffff                         51     # total 2040
 5      # 200 amounts of 1
e8030000                                 6      # total 235
6400c8                                   8      # total 300 with a zero
